gloss: next fiscal year; next academic year

definitions.gloss: next fiscal year; next business or school year
definitions.explanation: The {年度|ねんど} after the current one — the business or academic year that begins next April in Japan, not simply the next calendar year.

examples.japanese: {来年度|らいねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: To make plans for next fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {来年度|らいねんど}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: A new system starts next fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {来年度|らいねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Next year's budget proposal is being debated in the Diet.

notes:
Refers to the ⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧ (business or academic year) that begins next April in Japan, not simply the next calendar year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {来年度|らいねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: next year's budget
- {来年度|らいねんど}⟦{以降|いこう}→以降：03999_ikou⟧: from next fiscal year onward

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{今年度|こんねんど}→今年度：28220_konnendo⟧: this fiscal year
- ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧: next (calendar) year — different reading and scope
